seq_edge_list.note: seq_edge_list s: the ordered list of the sets [set s_i; s_(i+1)] of consecutive entries, one per adjacent pair, (size s).-1 entries; repetitions and order are kept, [:: x; x] gives [set x], a non-adjacent pair is listed, reversal reverses the list.

seq_edge_set.note: seq_edge_set s: the finite support of seq_edge_list s, equal to the existential image of the consecutive pairs; empty on [::] and one-entry sequences, at most (size s).-1 elements, invariant under reversal; inside E(G) on walks.

seq_index_consecutive.note: seq_index_consecutive p x y: the first occurrences of x and y in p are adjacent positions; on duplicate-free p with x, y in p it is adjacency of entries; an absent vertex has index size p, so the relation alone does not imply membership.

seq_index_edge_set.note: seq_index_edge_set p: the actual edges [set x; y] (x -- y) with x, y in p first-index adjacent; always inside E(G), empty on [::], one-entry sequences and non-adjacent pairs, equal to seq_edge_set p :&: E(G) on duplicate-free p and to seq_edge_set p on duplicate-free walks; not reversal-invariant in general.
